definitions.explanation: The way something or someone is treated, managed, or dealt with. Applies to both physical handling of objects and the manner in which people or matters are dealt with.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}は{扱|あつか}いが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: This machine is difficult to handle.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}{扱|あつか}いされるのは{嫌|いや}だ。
examples.english: I hate being treated like a child.

examples.japanese: {個人情報|こじんじょうほう}の{扱|あつか}いには{十分|じゅうぶん}{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be very careful in handling personal information.

notes:
{扱|あつか}い is the noun form of {扱|あつか}う (to handle, to deal with). It is extremely versatile and appears in many compound expressions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{扱|あつか}い: treated as ~ (used as a suffix)
- {扱|あつか}いが{難|むずか}しい / {扱|あつか}いにくい: hard to handle
- {扱|あつか}いに{困|こま}る: to have trouble dealing with

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特別|とくべつ}{扱|あつか}い: special treatment
- {子供|こども}{扱|あつか}い: treating someone like a child
- {人間|にんげん}{扱|あつか}いされない: not treated as a human being
- {取|と}り{扱|あつか}い: handling, management (compound noun)
- {取|と}り{扱|あつか}い{注意|ちゅうい}: handle with care
- {扱|あつか}い{方|かた}: how to handle, way of dealing with
